autonomous_wave.goal: Fail closed when the primary IOFileStore-managed root, managed directories or existing managed leaves are redirected by symlinks while preserving safe resolver/API behavior.
autonomous_wave.rationale: Lexical standardized-path containment was insufficient for real filesystem authority: an existing symlink could remain lexically under root while redirecting reads/writes/removals outside it. This is a direct portable data-safety invariant and higher priority than optional performance or UX work.
